IWA-M11-4B.html:
Has a military style fly off lever assembly with a straight pin pull and safety clip release system.

The M11 is a multiple bang device that gives the operator an advantage when entering a situation where a target needs to be distracted into believing the assault has started from multiple entry points. There are four rapid consecutive bangs with bright flashes.

It is designed with a 2 second delay incorporated within the base ejecting sound unit which is constructed from tough recyclable plastic. The delay/sound unit within the device is full waterproofed as an addition benefit for the end user. The body is constructed from an HDPE plastic which is both a strong and durable. The overall design and shape of the M11 ensures that it will fit modern assault vests and webbing equipment currently on today’s market.

It’s always recommended to remain behind cover when deploying and using our products during any type of training, simulation and CQB environment.

The use of this product is intended for military / law enforcement / private security training and simulation / Milsim.

The use of this product requires eye protection, ear protection and gloves.

Please refer to terms and conditions for product SDS and Performance sheet.

IWA-M14.html:
M14 Smoke Deployment Device

The M14 has a new metal military style fly off lever and straight pin pull mechanism and a safety clip release system, producing a high-density output of rich bright color smoke for approximately 45 seconds and is available in all the colors listed below.

The M14 is designed as a dual vented device for quick output cover/screening smoke replicating a military composition. The M14 body is constructed from an HDPE plastic which is both a strong, durable and making it fully waterproof.

The overall design and shape of the M14 was to ensure it fits in modern assault vests and webbing equipment currently on the market. Images may vary from actual product.

Safety Distance: 5 Meters

Fuse Burn Time: 2.5 Seconds (+/-0.5 sec)

Smoke Emission Time: Average 45-55 sec (Not including fuse burn)

Sound Level (db): Negligible

Output: Dense smoke coverage

Product motion from test point: 1 meter from firing point

Fragment Zone: N/A

Destruction: N/A

Safety Equipment: Please refer to Product SDS & User Instructions

Product Dimensions: Height 121mm x Width 44mm

The use of this product is intended for military / law enforcement / private security training and simulation / Milsim.

The use of this product requires eye protection, ear protection and gloves.

Please refer to terms and conditions for product MSDS and Performance sheet.
